text:
Nora: Quick repro from onboarding run: Node sampleapp intermittently loses req-id and prints DEBUG logs even though REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO. Suspect OTel init ordering.

Nora: Repro steps: git clone internal/sampleapp-telemetry && npm i && REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO node server.js (with OTEL envs set) then curl /api/hello repeatedly.

Nora: Example sanitized log: 
INFO  [req=abc123] handler start
DEBUG [req=] retry attempt 2 headers: { authorization: 'Bearer sk-xxx' }
INFO  [req=] handler done

Priya: Two likely causes: 1) OTel auto-instrumentation sets child logger levels after our logger init, 2) instrumentations re-emit requests and our req-id stored in req.locals/context gets lost.

Lin: Short-term workaround: call require('@redwood/telemetry').register() before logger.init() or call logger.setLevel(process.env.REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL || 'info') after telemetry init. But we should fix SDK to be order-independent.

Priya: Agreed. Proposed SDK changes: - lazy-evaluate log level on first log and expose logger.reconfigure() - attach req-id to raw http.IncomingMessage (or copy into X-Redwood-Req header) so wrappers can't drop it - make redactor coerce Buffer/Uint8Array and deep-scan nested header shapes, mask auth keys keeping last 6 chars.

Nora: I pushed a tiny repro branch that stresses the race: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-telemetry/branch/otel-ordering-repro

telemetry-bot: Created ticket DX-7810: "OTel ordering causes req-id loss and log level flips; redactor misses buffered headers". Assigned Priya & Lin; priority P2.

Lin: I'll implement redactor changes and add tests for Buffer/nested headers. Priya, can you prototype logger.reconfigure() and a small integration test where telemetry calls reconfigure after registering?

Priya: Yep. Also will add an onboarding README note and a CLI startup warning if OTEL_* env vars are present without explicit REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL.

Nora: Thanks. Adding note to customer onboarding checklist to reduce support noise until we ship the fix.
